GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091. (19 Oct 45) ESS-IN
(SCAPIN - 159)
19 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : The Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Fourth Naval Fuel Depot, Shimen-mura, Kasuga-gun, Fukuoka Prefecture
1. Reference is made to CLO 201, 7 October 1945, requesting authority to transfer control of the Fourth Naval Fuel Depot to the Transportation Ministry.
2. The transfer of this Naval Fuel Depot directly from the Japanese Navy to the Department of Transportation is disapproved.
3. The Home Ministry has been designated as the official agency of the Imperial Japanese Government to receive such transfers.
4. A request for the transfer of this Naval Fuel Depot to the Home Ministry will be given consideration if submitted.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
